research_question: Under temporal and AML-typology shift, does reliability-gated case-level context improve laundering-case recovery per analyst hour over score-only and generic feature-attribution review at a fixed queue capacity?
unit_of_randomization: case_id, falling back to event_id when no labelled laundering case exists
guardrails: No label, case ID, typology, investigator outcome, or post-event field may enter a model feature.
All rolling features use the half-open historical interval [event_time - window, event_time).
Preprocessing statistics and category vocabularies are fitted on train only.
Reviewer-facing queue files are physically separated from evaluation labels.
Study-arm assignment is deterministic and case-consistent.
sprint_1_status: harness and leakage boundaries implemented; model explanations and human-subject evaluation are intentionally deferred
